subject: Fiscal Crisis and School Budget Inquiries
overview: The Council addressed a projected $8.2 million budget shortfall caused by the pandemic and requested a plan for in-person budget hearings. Members approved several resolutions seeking historical spending data from the school department and authorized Community Preservation Act funds for electrical upgrades at the Medford Historical Society.

items.title: Draft Ordinance Progress Reports
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring monthly administration reports on the status of draft ordinances and a copy of the contract with KP Law.

items.title: In-Person Budget Hearings Plan
items.summary: The Council approved a request for the Council President to meet with the Mayor to develop a plan for conducting upcoming budget hearings in a non-virtual setting.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Safety Issues
items.summary: Approved a resolution to address people abusing social criteria and creating safety hazards at the cemetery, such as children playing on grave sites.

items.title: Face Mask Distribution Update
items.summary: Chief of Staff Rodriguez announced the city would distribute 5,000 masks via a drive-through at Hormel Stadium, with another 5,000 reserved for seniors and vulnerable residents.

items.title: Lieutenant Michael Endicott Retirement
items.summary: The Council commended and congratulated Lieutenant Michael Endicott on his retirement following 32 years of service in the Medford Fire Department.

items.title: Courtyard Nursing Home Crisis Inquiry
items.summary: Council dedicated the meeting to coronavirus victims and approved a request for a timeline of city and state responses to the outbreak at the Courtyard nursing home.

items.title: Municipal Budget Deficit and Federal Lobbying
items.summary: Following reports of an $8.2 million shortfall, the Council voted to lobby federal and state delegations for a bailout to offset revenue losses.

items.title: School Department Financial Records Request
items.summary: Approved a series of resolutions requesting detailed school department records from 2017 to 2020, including supplemental appropriations, salary increases, and historical budget votes.

items.title: CPA Funds for Medford Historical Society
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $4,000 in Community Preservation Act funds for electrical upgrades at the Medford Historical Society and Museum building.

items.title: Condolences and Appointments
items.summary: Approved condolences for longtime city employees Alice Durant Rapallo and Dick Crocker, and announced the appointment of Councilor Bears to the Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust.
